title: Coral Form Study: Mushroom Coral
description: The purpose of this coral form study was to understand organic forms and how they can be applied in different ways. The form was taken as inspiration for CNC-routed panels, as conceptual ideas for sound dampening and large-scale coarse water filtration.

brief.label: Study
brief.text: Understanding the organic form of mushroom coral and how it can be applied elsewhere.

brief.label: Applications
brief.text: CNC-routed panels, as concepts for sound dampening and large-scale coarse water filtration.

study_intro: Reading a natural form for what it could become: folded, ruffled surfaces translated into something a machine can cut.

study.label: Form
study.text: The folds and ridges of mushroom coral, captured as one continuous rippling surface.

study.label: Translation
study.text: Sectioned into contour ribs, so the form can be CNC-routed as panels.

study.label: Application
study.text: Concepts for sound dampening and large-scale coarse water filtration.

study.label: Finish
study.text: Glossy black, lit to show every fold.
